a.lede: Cybersecurity company Check Point has confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-85102, a pre-authentication remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the VPN certificate-handling functionality of its Security Gateway product. [...]
a.title: Check Point warns of hackers exploiting Security Gateway VPN RCE flaw
